timeline_events.summary: Chris Brown is on a tour with upcoming performances at venues including the O2 Arena in London, Nottingham Trent FM Arena, Odyssey Arena in Belfast, and the O2 Arena in Dublin.
Chris Brown is scheduled to perform at the O2 Arena in London.
Chris Brown performs a concert in London featuring dancers, DJs, and drummers, with special effects and energy driving the show.

Chris Brown handed himself in to Los Angeles police over an alleged assault on an unidentified woman believed to be his girlfriend, Rihanna, and both subsequently canceled their scheduled Grammy performances.
Chris Brown was charged with making criminal threats after an alleged physical altercation with Rihanna, which is under police investigation.
Chris Brown stated he was "sorry and saddened" over what transpired following his alleged assault of Rihanna, without confirming the allegations.
Chris Brown is expected to appear in court, although no formal charges have yet been filed, following an alleged assault on Rihanna.
US singer Chris Brown is charged with two felonies, assault likely to cause great bodily injury and making criminal threats, stemming from an argument with his girlfriend Rihanna.
Rihanna's lawyer says she may testify against Chris Brown, who faces felony assault charges for an alleged altercation on 2009-02-08.
Nickelodeon faces pressure from an online petition with over 10,000 signatures to disqualify Chris Brown from its music awards over assault charges related to an alleged attack on Rihanna.

A representative for producer Polow Da Don confirmed that Rihanna and Chris Brown recorded a reunion duet earlier that week, days after Brown was charged with two felonies for the alleged assault of Rihanna.
A survey by the Boston Public Health Commission found that nearly half of Boston-area teenagers say Rihanna was responsible for Chris Brown's alleged Grammy night attack.
Chris Brown pleaded not guilty to charges of threatening and assaulting his girlfriend, singer Rihanna.
Chris Brown's lawyer, Mark Geragos, argues in a Los Angeles court for the assault case to be dismissed due to media leaks and requests another hearing postponement.
Chris Brown posted an online video announcing his comeback and denying being a "monster" in his first public comments since his alleged assault of Rihanna.
Chris Brown pleaded guilty to one count of felony assault for assaulting Rihanna, avoiding a prison sentence and receiving supervised probation and community labour.
Chris Brown was sentenced to 180 days' community labour and five years' probation after pleading guilty to assaulting Rihanna before the 2009 Grammy awards.
Chris Brown was formally sentenced to five years' probation and 180 days of community labour after his February assault of Rihanna.
Chris Brown admitted he remembers assaulting Rihanna, saying his earlier statement that he did not recall the incident was a misstatement and blaming editing of his Larry King Live interview.
Chris Brown's interview with Larry King about beating ex-girlfriend Rihanna is spoofed online.
Representatives for Chris Brown deny that he will perform at a Michael Jackson tribute concert, while organizers say his participation depends on a US judge's approval.
Chris Brown has begun serving 180 days of community labour after pleading guilty to assaulting Rihanna.
Chris Brown released a new video, with behind-the-scenes shots posted.
Rihanna describes Chris Brown as her first big love in her first interview since he assaulted her in February.
Rihanna says in her first interview since Chris Brown assaulted her in February that her brief reconciliation with him was embarrassing and warns young women against staying in abusive relationships.
Chris Brown prepares to release his new album Graffiti following his guilty plea to felony assault on ex-girlfriend Rihanna, with uncertainty over whether the charge will affect his record sales.
Timbaland dropped Chris Brown from his forthcoming album Shock Value II, with the decision described as mutual.
Calvin Harris accuses Chris Brown of plagiarizing his single "I'm Not Alone" with Brown's song "Yeah 3x," though Harris says he has no plans to sue.
Chris Brown's album FAME is released on RCA.
Chris Brown reportedly trashed his dressing room and cancelled a performance after a Good Morning America interview repeatedly asked him about his 2009 attack on Rihanna.
Chris Brown is cast in the romantic comedy film Think Like a Man, two years after pleading guilty to assaulting Rihanna.
Chris Brown wins best R&B album and performs twice at the Grammy Awards, his return after missing the 2009 ceremony for assaulting then-girlfriend Rihanna.
Chris Brown was accused of stealing a woman's mobile phone outside a Miami Beach nightclub, an incident that could lead to jail time due to his probation.
Rihanna defends her decision to collaborate with Chris Brown on two new songs, calling it "innocent" and explaining he is "the hottest R&B artist out right now."
Rihanna defends her decision to collaborate with ex-boyfriend Chris Brown on new versions of her track Birthday Cake and his single Turn Up the Music, and does not rule out a future romantic reunion.
Chris Brown's fifth album Fortune is expected to reach No 1 in the UK, marking a career comeback without contrition after his 2009 felony assault conviction.
Chris Brown's new neck tattoo, which resembles an image of a battered woman, draws widespread criticism and comparisons to Rihanna's 2009 assault.
Chris Brown denied that his new tattoo depicts a beaten Rihanna, saying it is art intended to represent a Mexican sugar skull.
Chris Brown denies his new tattoo depicts a beaten Rihanna.
Chris Brown's album Fortune was covered with protest stickers in London HMV stores reading "Warning, do not buy this album! This man beats women."
Protesters put warning stickers on Chris Brown's CDs condemning him for beating up ex-girlfriend Rihanna.
Irish rap trio Original Rudeboys turned down an offer to perform with Chris Brown, citing his 2009 assault on Rihanna.
Chris Brown deleted his Twitter account after being goaded by comic writer Jenny Johnson.
Chris Brown is named as a suspect in a battery report after a brawl with Frank Ocean outside a Los Angeles recording studio, with Ocean seeking prosecution.
Chris Brown is under investigation for an alleged assault in a West Hollywood parking lot after a fight over a parking space.
Chris Brown posted a painting of himself as Jesus on the cross on Instagram with the caption "Painting the way I feel today. Focus on what matters!" following his spat with Frank Ocean.
Rihanna confirms she is back together with Chris Brown, who assaulted her in 2009.
The Chris Brown Channel App became available for iPhone, iPad and iPod touch.

Chris Brown was allegedly involved in a minor car crash in Los Angeles, and officials are investigating whether he violated his probation by refusing to cooperate and providing false insurance information.
Chris Brown collapsed and suffered a non-epileptic seizure while working at a Los Angeles recording studio.
A judge dismissed the remaining hit-and-run charge against Chris Brown after he reached a civil compromise with the victim.
Chris Brown and a man reported to be his bodyguard were arrested and charged with felony assault following an altercation outside the W Hotel in Washington.
Chris Brown pleads not guilty to an assault charge after an alleged fight outside a Washington hotel.
Chris Brown checked himself out of a rehabilitation facility after two weeks and will continue his programme as an outpatient while undertaking community service.
Chris Brown was sent back to rehab and ordered by a court to a three-month residential treatment program after being expelled from an anger management center.
Chris Brown is sued for allegedly attacking Malcolm Ausbon during a basketball game on 2013-07-29, with Brown's lawyer calling the lawsuit extortion.
A Los Angeles judge ordered Chris Brown to remain in his anger management and drug rehabilitation programme for another two months until he stands trial for assault in April.
A judge ordered Chris Brown to remain in jail until 23 April following his second ejection from an anger management programme.
Chris Brown was sentenced to one year in jail for violating probation in connection with a fight in Washington last autumn, with credit for 234 days already served in rehab and custody.
Authors of the book "He Who Must be Obeid" will offer a formal apology to Chris Brown after the book was pulled from shelves due to defamation action over a mistaken identity.
Chris Brown pleaded guilty to misdemeanor assault for hitting a man outside a Washington hotel and was sentenced to time served.
Chris Brown tweets to his followers that the Ebola epidemic is "a form of population control."

A Washington, DC, court ruled that Chris Brown and his bodyguard Christopher Hollosy will not serve additional jail time for a 2013 misdemeanor assault, with Hollosy's 90-day sentence suspended and Brown having received time served.
Jamie Foxx releases the track "You Changed Me" featuring Chris Brown.
Chris Brown was criticized for posting an Instagram photo of a woman who allegedly broke into his house, where she was arrested for felony vandalism and burglary.
Australian activist group GetUp launched an online petition calling on immigration minister Peter Dutton to deny Chris Brown entry to Australia for his December tour due to his assault conviction.
Australia's immigration minister formally denied Chris Brown's visa application to tour the country on character grounds.

Australia's immigration minister issued a notice of intention to consider refusing Chris Brown a visa for his planned December tour, though his representatives remain hopeful he will be allowed to enter.
Chris Brown cancelled his tour of Australia and New Zealand seven days before his first show was due to take place.
Chris Brown was arrested on suspicion of assault with a deadly weapon after an hours-long standoff at his Los Angeles home.
In a new documentary, Chris Brown discusses his 2009 assault of ex-girlfriend Rihanna, saying he felt like a monster and that it will haunt him forever.
Raef, a new signing to Awakening Records, released an Islamic version of Chris Brown's song "With You," replacing Brown's lyrics about love for a woman with lyrics expressing love for the Lord.
Wizkid is preparing to release his third album, which features a confirmed collaboration with Chris Brown.

facts.text: On 2009-02-08, Chris Brown handed himself in to Los Angeles police over an alleged assault on a woman believed to be his girlfriend Rihanna; both canceled their Grammy performances.

On 2009-06-22, Chris Brown pleaded guilty to one count of felony assault for assaulting Rihanna, avoiding prison and receiving supervised probation and community labour.
On 2009-08-27, Chris Brown was formally sentenced to five years' probation and 180 days of community labour after his February assault of Rihanna.
On 2009-11-03, Rihanna describes Chris Brown as her first big love in her first interview since he assaulted her in February.
On 2013-01-31, Rihanna confirms she is back together with Chris Brown, who assaulted her in 2009.
On 2014-05-09, Chris Brown was sentenced to one year in jail for violating probation over a Washington fight, with credit for 234 days already served in rehab and custody.
On 2015-05-05, Chris Brown was criticized for posting an Instagram photo of a woman who allegedly broke into his house, where she was arrested for felony vandalism and burglary.
